verses.text: Three times a day [Daniel] got down on his knees, and prayed, giving thanks to his God, just as he had done before.
verses.title: Power of Consistent Prayer

verses.text: For just as each of us has one body with many members, and these members do not all have the same function, so in Christ we, though many, form one body, and each member belongs to all the others.
Jesus replied: “ ‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.’
